close_reason: OID_EMAIL_ADDRESS moved before check_name_constraints doc comment block
description: Lines 1357-1361: OID_EMAIL_ADDRESS is declared AFTER the section divider comment and the start of check_name_constraints's doc comment, but BEFORE the function itself. The const is visually inside the docstring. The result: the docstring for check_name_constraints is visually split by the const definition at line 1360. Rustdoc attaches the docstring above the const (since the const immediately follows), not the function. Future contributors reading the rendered docs will see a truncated docstring on check_name_constraints. The const should be moved before the section comment block, or at minimum before the function's ///-doc lines.
title: OID_EMAIL_ADDRESS const is placed inside check_name_constraints section comment block
